flow: Online source: install immutable model/runtime profiles; real inference + voices + performance verification
Export ZIP Store or folder (full path; never overwrite)
Move by local storage; target inspect files/platform/disk
Import verified fingerprint into immutable managed paths; atomic Bolt activation
Restart -> diagnose target -> start engine -> actual local STT/translation/TTS -> load and reboot trials

requiredDefaultAssets: selected-language Supertonic3 and/or Kokoro ONNX model bundles
optional: currently running Windows EXE (stored separately; no automatic execution)
implemented.profileExtensibility: Immutable HF commit/SHA/format/prompt/model registry transfers without HF lookup; custom executable/runtime rejected; schema/version compatibility fails closed; schema1 exact older tree-metadata and VC DLL4 descriptor accepted only after current source-tree and installer identity validation
security: safe settings allowlist; target credentials remain local
inspected manifest fingerprint bound to import
environment mutation gate and idle import
running operation on restart shown interrupted
Immutable source-archive-derived complete file tree pin; reject rewritten file+installed manifest and forged portable tree
implemented.transferEfficiency: Large GGUF/GGML exported/imported with one full payload pass while hashing; no model-sized RAM buffer; runtime tree retains separate archive profile and extracted hashes

targetValidation.GPU_NPU_RAM: target diagnostic candidates; actual inference readiness is separate

remainingAcceptance: Actual Windows EXE launch in VM
Actual installed model + language voice roundtrip with OS egress blocked
Offline target drivers and bundled ONNX speech model execution verification
Full-size multi-GB transfer and disk-full/power-loss at each phase
30/100/320 actual inference scale and >=8h runtime trial
Conservative automatic cleanup of uncommitted crash orphan directories
internetBoundary: Backend HTTP denied counter=0 in fixture roundtrip; browser app requests local only. Entire OS outbound traffic was not blocked/measured. Import uses OS diagnostics, but never runs imported binaries.
crossDeviceNotes: Mobile may join offline PC over local authenticated HTTPS LAN with role-scoped QR. Native Android environment migration is not implemented.
